verdict.rationale: Superset claims you can "run your agents from your phone" and offers remote access. It notifies you when an agent finishes or pauses for your input. Together these imply you can respond to blocked agents remotely while others keep running in parallel, but no evidence describes an actual approval flow on mobile. Missing for 10: a documented mobile approval/permission-prompt workflow, detail on what the phone experience supports (approving tool calls or decisions vs. just viewing), mobile push notification specifics, and independent hands-on corroboration of phone use.
